'''Marty Terwilliger''' (Marty Twigg) flew with [[Team Albany]] to [[DecipherCon 2000]] and printed the red McDonald's shirts with "Team Albany" on the front. Matt Sokol's trip report lists him as travel and family, not as a dested constructed member of the Sunday team event.<ref name="sokol-dt">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-sokols-dcon-2000-reportd1327/ sokols-dcon-2000-report], Matt Sokol, Decktech (11 October 2000)</ref> He played the [[2012 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2012/2012mpcday1.pdf 2012 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
